Weng.CodeGen
Class Symbol

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.CodeGen.Symbol
public class Symbol
extends java.lang.Object

Use an object of class Symbol to represent miscellaneous and preparatory function codes, such as G01 and M00. As function codes often override each other, Symbol objects should be related to each other via a Group object.
